summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-G1 admits no external crate. academic-policy reuses rusqlite, sha2, thiserror, and proptest from earlier reviewed receipts; it adds only one workspace path package.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-policy is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It owns immutable policy hashing, default-deny evaluation, minimized grants, atomic one-use consumption, and metadata-only audit persistence so no caller can skip from a request directly to a runtime tool invocation.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, reads no environment variable, spawns no process, and runs no build script. Its only host capability is an in-memory bundled SQLite connection; runtime payload bytes are transiently hashed and are not stored.
advisory_path: Unchanged. Every external crate academic-policy links was admitted by an earlier receipt and is triaged through that receipt's advisory path. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request.
